block_records.function: ATmega32U4-AU USB MCU, 5 V supply/decoupling, reset, UCAP, and pin map.
adaptations: Uses 16 MHz external crystal, all supply pins locally decoupled, 1 µF UCAP, 10 kΩ reset pull-up, prototype USB descriptor limited to 100 mA.
checks: ERC and schematic parity are zero; pin/firmware contract passes 35 checks; power budget is documented.

block_records.function: USB-C USB2 sink front end, CC termination, VBUS fuse/bulk, reversible USB2 data pins.
adaptations: Uses USB4085 USB2-only through-hole receptacle, independent 5.1 kΩ CC resistors, 250 mA PPTC, and 4.7 µF bulk to retain capacitance margin. VBUS contacts escape without via-in-pad.
checks: Connectivity audit confirms both plug orientations; DRC passes the connector-only 0.15 mm adjacent-pad clearance; J1 is explicitly assigned to a post-reflow THT soldering process.

block_records.function: Low-capacitance USB D+/D− ESD protection between connector and series resistors.
adaptations: USBLC6-2SC6 is placed close to connector; protected pair passes through 22 Ω resistors to MCU.
checks: Exact MPN and SOT-23-6 pad geometry audited; USB length/width/topology audit passes.

block_records.function: 16 MHz crystal oscillator and load capacitors.
adaptations: Exact ABM8 12 pF load crystal uses equal 18 pF C0G loads based on 3 pF estimated stray.
checks: Calculation is archived; compact placement/routing reviewed; P001 start-up margin test is explicitly required before hardware claim.

block_records.function: Ten CHERRY MX switches with one series diode per key in a 2×5 COL2ROW scan matrix.
adaptations: PD0/PD1 rows and PB4/PB5/PB6/PC6/PD7 columns match QMK; default codes F13–F22.
checks: Netlist and firmware contract check passes; diode polarity is documented on silkscreen and assembly notes.

block_records.function: Reset, DFU software chord, and AVR-ISP recovery.
adaptations: Dedicated RESET button and 2×3 AVR-ISP header; hold Key 10 plus Key 1 to enter DFU from firmware.
checks: ISP header mapping and bootloader policy documented; firmware compile and contract audit pass.

block_records.function: Board outline, USB opening datum, key grid, mounting holes, and component bodies.
adaptations: 101×73 mm bare board, 19.05 mm key grid, four 2.2 mm M2 holes; no enclosure/plate claim.
checks: Native board stats and mechanical contract agree; Gerber/STEP/renders reviewed; incomplete switch STEP is explicitly labeled.
